title: The Localization Bridge
facebook_comment_text: Many think "integration" is just connecting APIs. But true localization means understanding the *native* protocols, security nuances, and specific error codes of M-Pesa or WhatsApp in-region. It's the difference between a functional pipe and a resilient, optimized artery. 🤔 What hidden complexities have you uncovered in your local payment/comm integrations?
